definitions.explanation: The rate at which something moves or happens. Used for physical speed (of vehicles, movement) and figurative speed (of work, progress).

examples.japanese: スピード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧すぎないで。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧スピード⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧50⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧だ。
examples.english: The speed limit on this road is 50 km/h.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スピード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げない→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: If I don't pick up the pace at work a bit more, I won't make the deadline.

notes:
USAGE:
スピード is the standard loanword for speed and is used more frequently than the native ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ in everyday conversation, though ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ is preferred in technical and formal contexts.

スピード⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧ (speeding violation) and スピード⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (speed limit) are common in traffic-related contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スピード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to speed up, to go fast
- スピード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to slow down
- スピード⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: speed limit
- スピード⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧: speeding violation
- スピードアップ: speedup, acceleration
